about: Read-only Longhorn v1.11.3 Volume, Replica, Engine and retained core/v1 Event inventories. UID-bound native Events and latest failure/recovery/rebuild fields; missing or expired history is UNKNOWN, never inferred zero or trigger. No trim, volume attach/detach, mutation or setting changes. Same bounded inventory transport: 20s/128KiB per call, 150s/8MiB/128 calls total, 64 pages/4096 rows per list; collection and complete ordered raw attachments bounded to 180s.
